newsitem.title: ITALY: Court hearing for Italy's PM Prodi at 1400 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Court hearing for Italy's PM Prodi at 1400 GMT.

text.p: A hearing to examine a prosecutor's bid to try Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi for abuse of office and conflict of interest will be held at 1400 GMT on Wednesday.

Preliminary hearing judge Eduardo Landi has scheduled the close-door hearing in a Rome court to consider the request, which relates to events in 1993 when Prodi was chairman of the huge state holding group IRI.
The hearing is likely to open and then immediately be adjourned to a later date because one of the lawyers is required at a trial in the northern city of Turin.
Prodi, who has led a centre-left coalition since last May, denies any wrongdoing.
